questions.question: Please qualify the opening description of the Frobenius problem as unsolved. The post itself gives a complete two-denomination solution and a polynomial-time algorithm for any fixed number of denominations. Kannan’s 1992 paper explicitly gives that algorithm: https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01204720 . Please distinguish lack of a simple general formula, complexity with a variable number of denominations, and particular open questions. The source opening remains; the description avoids the generalisation.

localizations.ru: Уточнить начальное «среди нерешённых … остаётся проблема Фробениуса». Ниже сам текст сообщает о полном решении для двух номиналов и полиномиальном алгоритме при фиксированном их числе. У Каннана, Lattice translates of a polytope and the Frobenius problem (1992), явно дан такой алгоритм: https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01204720 . Следует развести отсутствие простой общей формулы, вычислительную сложность при переменном числе номиналов и конкретные открытые вопросы. Авторское начало сохранено; дайджест не повторяет это обобщение.

questions.resolution: The opening now distinguishes the lack of a general formula for an arbitrary number of denominations from completely solved cases, consistently with Kannan’s fixed-dimension algorithm. https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01204720

questions.question: Please state the formulas’ domain. For coprime a, b > 1 there is a largest nonrepresentable positive amount. If a denomination is 1, every nonnegative amount is representable and the value −1 requires an explicit convention. The same boundary issue applies to F(ab, ac, bc). Please agree a short clarification in both versions.

questions.resolution: The general statement now requires positive integer denominations with gcd 1, and the two- and three-parameter formulas explicitly require parameters greater than 1.
